p, k = map(int, input().split())
MOD = 10**9 + 7
res = 1

if k == 0:
    for _ in range(p - 1):
        res = (res * p) % MOD
else:
    parent = list(range(p))
    componentSize = [1] * p
    cc = p

    def findParent(x):
        while parent[x] != x:
            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
            x = parent[x]
        return x

    def merge(a, b):
        nonlocal cc
        a = findParent(a)
        b = findParent(b)
        if a == b:
            return False
        if componentSize[a] < componentSize[b]:
            a, b = b, a
        parent[b] = a
        componentSize[a] += componentSize[b]
        cc -= 1
        return True

    for i in range(p):
        to = (k * i) % p
        merge(i, to)

    if k > 1:
        s = set()
        for i in range(p):
            s.add(findParent(i))
        cc = len(s)

    for _ in range(cc):
        res = (res * p) % MOD

print(res)
